name: vscode-codex-usage
description: Show Codex CLI usage in the VS Code status bar.

enumDescriptions: Query the Codex API when logged in, otherwise read local rollout files.
Always query the Codex API using the logged-in credential (falls back to rollout files if the query fails).
codexUsage.source.description: Where usage data comes from: live Codex API (online) or local rollout files (offline).

codexUsage.compactStatusBar.description: Show a compact status bar chip (icon + single percent) instead of the full per-window breakdown.

codexUsage.showRemaining.description: Show remaining usage ("% left", counting down from 100%) instead of used usage, like the Codex CLI.

from.description: Used percent at which this colour starts.

codexUsage.usageColors.description: Colours of the tooltip usage bars by used percent. Each step applies from its `from` value up to the next step; usage below the lowest `from` uses the lowest step's colour. Thresholds always use percent used, even with showRemaining. Invalid entries are ignored; an empty or fully invalid list restores the defaults.

enumDescriptions: Do not highlight the status bar item.
Use the theme warning background from 75% used and the error background from 90% used. Ignores usageColors.
Highlight the whole status bar item with the usageColors colour for the current used percent.
codexUsage.statusBarBackground.markdownDescription: How the status bar item is highlighted. VS Code only allows the theme warning and error colours as a real status bar background, so `usage` colours the entire item (icon and text) with the active `usageColors` colour — that is the supported way to highlight the whole item in a custom colour. The default in the schema stays `thresholds` (the previous behaviour). The first time this setting ships, the extension sets it to `usage` if you have not chosen a value; later updates do not change it.

enumDescriptions: Show the usage item on the left side of the status bar.
Show the usage item on the right side of the status bar.
codexUsage.statusBarAlignment.description: Which side of the status bar the Codex usage item appears on.

codexUsage.codexHome.description: Path to the Codex home directory. Empty means use ~/.codex.

codexUsage.refreshIntervalSeconds.description: How often to refresh usage (query the API or re-read rollout files), in seconds.

codexUsage.lookbackDays.description: How many days back to search for rollout files.
